Supreme Court Seeks Report on Delhi Women's Safety

The Supreme Court has requested a report concerning the safety of women and children in Delhi-NCR. The court's inquiry comes amid concerns that authorities have been lax regarding women's safety in Delhi. One report highlighted the court's question, 'Why Do They Feel Entitled To Ask Any Woman?'
